other_conditions: Minimum imprisonment of six months before Independence (reduced to three months for women, SC/ST freedom fighters).
Ex‑INA personnel eligible if imprisonment/detention was outside India.
Underground persons for more than six months who were proclaimed offenders, had an arrest warrant, or a detention order issued but not served.
Persons interned in their home or externed from their district for six months or more.
Persons whose property was confiscated, attached or sold due to participation in the freedom struggle.
Persons permanently incapacitated during firing or lathi charge.
Persons who lost a Central or State Government job because of participation in the national movement.

Eligible dependents (if the freedom fighter is deceased) include mother, father, widower/widow (if not remarried) and unmarried daughters; only one dependent can receive a pension with priority order: widow/widower, unmarried daughters, mother, father.
Pension for unmarried daughters ceases upon marriage or when they become independent.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly pension ranging from ₹26,000 to ₹30,000 (including 3% Dearness Relief) for eligible freedom fighters and their dependents.
